forward_disclosure.old_literal_configuration_values: 256 versus8 are true generic pib_entries values; they are not active capacity comparison. Active CH common=256 and DH OO=128.
forward_disclosure.future_delta_rule: Only subtract an explicitly measured same-scope field at both printed boundaries; do not generalize prev.get(k,0). Current four-source data has no late appearing additive fields. Row_Buffer_Locality_write appears later but is a ratio and excluded.
